annotations.title: Subscribe an email to new developments or construction

description: Email the person new developments or new construction licences (double opt-in). New-build developments match a filter (city, typology, price; daily), or newly licensed construction in a municipality (weekly). Ask the person first: this only sends a confirmation email, and nothing is active until they click the link. One-click unsubscribe in every email.

city.description: Municipality, Portuguese name (Porto, Lisboa). Required for construction; empty means all of Portugal for new_developments

client.description: Optional. Your app's host or name, e.g. claude.ai or chatgpt.com: recorded as the request's source

language.description: The person's language: pt, en, ru, ua, de, fr, nl (uk is accepted too). The consent text and the emails come in it. Default: en

on_sale.description: Optional, new_developments: only developments on sale

parish.description: Optional, construction only: a parish (freguesia) of that municipality

price_max.description: Optional, new_developments: maximum price in euros

price_min.description: Optional, new_developments: minimum price in euros

typology.description: Optional. Bedroom counts wanted (T2 = two bedrooms)

what.description: new_developments (default): new-build developments matching the filter, daily email when something new appears. construction: newly licensed construction in a municipality ("what is being built"), weekly

name: subscribe_digest
title: Subscribe an email to new developments or construction
